_doc: Items that are neither ship components (components.json) nor raw materials (materials.json): ammo, crew gear and special finds. Content is data: add an entry here and recipes and cargo can name it. kind: ammo (spent by weapons that name it in their `ammo` field; `explosive: true` makes a wrecked ammo rack holding it blow up, data/ammo.json), gear (crew equipment, craftable) special (found, bought or earned only: it never has a recipe) or mod (a boarding mod, one item per tier, slot kit: worn in a kit slot, found or bought, never built; data/mods.json). Fuel is special: one jump of the Drift campaign burns one. `does` (optional) replaces the line the kind gives in the part description (data/describe.json items): the repair drone is gear that turns into a crew-like body aboard (Jobs.launch_drones).

items.name: Fuel
items.blurb: One jump's worth. Every Rusthold sells it by the can, and every can costs more than the last.

items.name: Rounds
items.blurb: Loose rounds for the hand weapons. Boarding parties never carry enough.

items.name: Missile
items.blurb: Slow, guided and loud about it. Artemis launchers eat these.

items.name: Pistol
items.blurb: Loud enough, reliable enough. The crew's first argument-settler.

items.name: Rifle
items.blurb: Longer reach, steadier hands. Boarding parties love it.

items.name: Basic Armour
items.blurb: Polymer plates stitched over a flight suit. Stops a bruise, not a bullet.

items.name: EVA Suit
items.blurb: Thin, pressurised and unfashionable. Lets a crew member breathe in a vented room.

items.name: Exosuit
items.blurb: A powered frame with servos and attitude. Found aboard engineering and command decks, never built.

items.name: Salamander Suit
items.blurb: Immune to fire, but slow. Strolls through the flames, unhurried.

items.name: Heat Suit
items.blurb: Insulated for hot rooms: work beside a Prism Core without cooking.

items.name: Slugthrower
items.blurb: A basalt heavy: slow, loud, and it does not ask twice. Found aboard, never built.

items.name: Plasma Rifle
items.blurb: A hand-held star. Turns up in locked crates and is never sold twice.

items.name: Doorbuster
items.blurb: A breaching shotgun off a pirate's belt. Short range, a lot of opinion.

items.name: Flare Gun
items.blurb: A scavenger's last resort. Lights a room for both sides.

items.name: Repair Drone
items.does: Flies by itself: repairs, fights fires, reloads ammo.
items.blurb: One lens, one tool arm, no opinions. It works slower than a crew member, never mans a station, and when it breaks someone with a spanner can wake it again.

items.name: Spotter Cam Mk I
items.blurb: A shoulder camera that patches into the site's own. It sees what the dark would keep from you.

items.name: Salvage Rig Mk I
items.blurb: A harness of clamps and a loader's patience. Whatever you open comes out heavier.

items.name: Salvage Rig Mk II
items.blurb: A harness of clamps and a loader's patience. Whatever you open comes out heavier.

items.name: Salvage Rig Mk III
items.blurb: A harness of clamps and a loader's patience. Whatever you open comes out heavier.

items.name: Overcharge Coil Mk I
items.blurb: A coil wound round the grip. The gun hates it and hits harder for it.

items.name: Overcharge Coil Mk II
items.blurb: A coil wound round the grip. The gun hates it and hits harder for it.

items.name: Overcharge Coil Mk III
items.blurb: A coil wound round the grip. The gun hates it and hits harder for it.

items.name: Rigger's Harness
items.blurb: Webbing, clips and a tool for every hand. Repairs go faster aboard, and door locks give up sooner on foot.

items.name: Firefighter's Coat
items.blurb: Layered foil and a reflective hem. Takes half the fire and puts it out faster; lighter than a Salamander Suit.

items.name: Medic's Sash
items.blurb: A white sash with a red cross, and a pouch of everything. Heals the room it stands in; G patches up the people beside you.

items.name: Jump Pack
items.blurb: Twin thrusters on a strap. G throws you four cells the way you aim, and the pack needs a few seconds to get its breath back.

items.name: Chitin Plate
items.blurb: Kett shell-work, riveted over a work harness. Heavy armour that bites back at whatever hits it. G braces for a few seconds.

items.name: Spore Mantle
items.blurb: A living cloak of spore caps. Slowly mends the allies near its wearer, on foot and aboard.

items.name: Prism Cloak
items.blurb: Cut glass on a cloak. Throws back a share of energy bolts on foot, and softens ion hits aboard.

items.name: Ballast Rig
items.blurb: Grundl freight weights on a frame: very heavy armour, no knocking its wearer over, and no hurry.

items.name: Tank Harness
items.blurb: A Mire breather tank on a light harness: sealed against bad air with no suit to cook in.

items.name: Forge Apron
items.blurb: Emberkin leather and ember rivets. Immune to fire, and a hot room does not slow its wearer.

items.name: Trader's Coat
items.blurb: A Fenn coat with brass buttons and many pockets. Shops pay a little more for what you sell while it is aboard.

items.name: Stone Plates
items.blurb: Basalt slabs strapped on in a row. Big armour, a slow walk.

items.name: Scrap Gauntlets
items.blurb: Gauntling fists welded from a wreck. Melee hits harder, and a wreck gives up more scrap.

items.name: Marine Plate
items.blurb: Human service plate in olive drab. Balanced armour, and a spare magazine holds more rounds.
